explanation: "Does there exist a rational Diophantine 7-tuple?", stated as existence. With 0 not excluded from IsDiophantineTuple, Gibbs' 6-tuple {11/192, 35/192, 155/27, 512/27, 1235/48, 180873/16} together with 0 is a 7-element "rational Diophantine tuple". I verified this numerically, since 0·x + 1 = 1. So the open question is trivially answered "yes" under this formalization. The definition must require nonzero elements, as its own docstring states.
